video_title: “I Feel Wise & Fresh.” | Rudy Gobert Preseason Sound | 09.29.26

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on evolving his defensive game for the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: You want to win, you got to evolve with the game, you got to adapt to the game.
quotes.quote: To win, you got to evolve with the game, you got to adapt to the game. So, I have been challenged in a lot of different ways throughout my career and I just had to overcome this. It is a challenge and opportunity, but I had to always challenge myself to be able to do the things that my team needs me to do. And at the same time, still stick to my superpower, stick to the things that I can do to really change the game and impact the game. And I truly believe that my superpower is to also be able to adapt.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on building chemistry with Jaden McDaniels
quotes.excerpt: He is very focused, very locked in, and he is listening a lot to all of us.
quotes.quote: It has been great. He is very focused, very locked in, and he is listening a lot to all of us. You can tell he wants to win, and that is the most important thing.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on Anthony Edwards' leadership and vocal growth
quotes.excerpt: I think he is just trusting everyone, trusting the coaching staff, and when there is something to say, I will say it.
quotes.quote: I think he is just trusting everyone, trusting the coaching staff, and when there is something to say, I will say it. And I am also a guy that connects individually, so just being able to talk to all of the guys and be there for them, but also challenge them when needed, and also being challenged when needed. But I think my leadership is really about the daily approach, doing the boring things, putting the work every day.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on Jaden McDaniels' growth as a player and person
quotes.excerpt: He has grown a lot as a man and as a player.
quotes.quote: He has grown a lot as a man and as a player. I have watched him being a teenager almost, and now he is a father. His game has evolved, but his emotional maturity has evolved a lot too, and his approach on the court and outside of the court. He puts so much work, and he is always listening, always willing to improve, and it has been amazing to watch him grow.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert on the importance of daily habits for team success
quotes.excerpt: It is about a mindset, it is about our daily habits, and it is about our resilience.
quotes.quote: It is about a mindset, it is about our daily habits, and it is about our resilience, and being willing to do the things that are boring over and over. In this game, we always talk about this, when it is game 43 and you play a team that is in the bottom of the rankings, how are we going to show up? Are we going to do those things? And those games mean a lot. Those games are going to make the difference between being top of the West or fighting for home court or fighting for playing.
